narrationTexts: I'll survey the codebase for `account_id` usage.
finalText:
**Big. 1082 hits, 94 files.** About 820 are safe.

| Do not rename | Why |
| --- | --- |
| [docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml) | Public contract. Frozen field name. |
| [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) | Right side is the wire name. |
| `migrations/*.sql`, 12 files | Applied history. Down steps break. |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk`, 4 files | Regenerated by `npm run vendor:refresh`. |

The DB column stays `account_id` too. So 175 SQL strings in the repo layer stay. A column rename needs a new migration first.

Next: ask them if the DB column is in scope.
